# Ismael Marin — Software Engineer & Tech Lead

Ruby on Rails · Rust · AI Engineering · Backend Architecture · MCP

Software engineer and technical leader with deep experience building backend systems, SaaS products, integrations, and engineering teams for U.S. and Latin American companies. Ruby on Rails is my deepest production ecosystem, while I now work regularly with Rust, Elixir/Phoenix, and Python, particularly around developer infrastructure and AI systems. I approach AI as a software engineering problem: clear specifications, useful context, tests, guardrails, and evals. I have worked remotely throughout my career and remain hands-on with architecture and implementation.

## Availability

Open to full-time, part-time, and contract opportunities.

## Selected production work

### Dealerware · May 2022–April 2026

Worked on distributed systems processing approximately 10,000 telematics events per minute. Authored 40+ ADRs/RFCs and contributed 370+ merged pull requests across 20+ production repositories. Led a zero-downtime Elasticsearch-to-OpenSearch migration that materially reduced infrastructure cost while preserving production availability.

### Nebula Ideas · Head of Strategy / Technical Advisor · 2010–Present

Advise startups and product teams on architecture, backend modernization, AI adoption, technical strategy, and product development while remaining hands-on with implementation.

## Open-source work

- **rails-ai-bridge:** MCP and context infrastructure that helps AI coding assistants understand Rails applications through generated project context and read-only introspection. RubyGems recorded more than 10,000 total downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC. https://github.com/igmarin/rails-ai-bridge
- **ruby-skill-bench:** Evaluates whether engineering skills and context improve AI-agent performance through isolated runs, baseline-versus-context comparison, and blind judging. RubyGems recorded more than 3,000 total downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC. https://github.com/igmarin/ruby-skill-bench
- **rails-agent-skills / ruby-core-skills:** Engineering skill libraries for Rails and Ruby development.
- **brigid:** A Rust CLI that turns a codebase into a multi-chapter Markdown tutorial with Mermaid diagrams, setup guidance, and an architecture overview. https://github.com/igmarin/brigid
- **rs-guard:** A Rust CLI for multi-provider AI reviews of GitHub pull requests, with local pre-commit mode and per-run metrics. https://github.com/nebulaideas/rs-guard
- **pi-vida:** A launcher for Pi and other coding-agent hosts that loads language-specific skills, safety controls, and workflows. https://github.com/igmarin/pi-vida
- **Rust skills:** [rust-core-skills](https://github.com/igmarin/rust-core-skills) covers ownership, type-driven design, error handling, project context, and Cargo TDD.
- **Elixir/Phoenix skills:** [elixir-phoenix-skills](https://github.com/igmarin/elixir-phoenix-skills) provides guidance for idiomatic Elixir, Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto, OTP, testing, security, and deployment.

Ruby on Rails, Rust, Elixir/Phoenix, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, REST APIs, OpenSearch, AWS, Docker, distributed systems, software architecture, DDD, hexagonal architecture, TDD, BDD, MCP, LLM integration, AI agents, evals, context engineering, guardrails, RAG, and technical leadership.
